temporal_state_chain.observed: Marilyn has been unusually quiet and withdrawn over the past few days despite normally being engaging. When Carolyn asks if everything is alright, Marilyn says she is overwhelmed by work and personal stuff and thanks Carolyn for asking.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Marilyn is normally engaging; her recent quietness and withdrawal are unusual and may mean something is wrong.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. Marilyn's response confirms she is dealing with work and personal stress, and she seems to appreciate Carolyn's concern rather than rejecting it.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Marilyn is overwhelmed by work and personal issues, and Carolyn can be a supportive colleague by checking in.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To offer support and be available if Marilyn wants to talk.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Marilyn responded curtly in a later interaction. When Carolyn shares her own tough experiences and says she hopes she did not overstep, Marilyn apologizes if she seemed off and says it has been a hard week.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Carolyn believes Marilyn is stressed and may be withdrawing. Marilyn's curtness makes Carolyn wonder if she overstepped or if Marilyn is upset with her, leaving Carolyn confused and hurt.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. Marilyn's apology and explanation suggest her curtness was due to a hard week, not necessarily personal rejection, and Carolyn's openness was accepted.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Marilyn is struggling and did not mean to hurt Carolyn; their relationship can be repaired through openness and support.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Initially confused and hurt, then reassured and relieved.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To clear up any misunderstanding and continue supporting Marilyn.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Marilyn appeared to respond positively to Carolyn's openness. When Carolyn invites Marilyn to a small weekend gathering, Marilyn says it sounds lovely, thanks her, and accepts.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Carolyn feels relieved and hopeful about their budding friendship after Marilyn's positive response to her openness.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. Marilyn's enthusiastic acceptance confirms she is interested in spending time together and strengthening their friendship.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Marilyn values the connection and may become a closer friend; Carolyn's invitation was welcomed.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To strengthen the bond by hosting Marilyn at the gathering.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Despite friendly interactions outside work, Carolyn perceives Marilyn as still maintaining professional distance at the bank. When Carolyn raises this, Marilyn says she did not realize it, apologizes, and agrees to talk about improving collaboration.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Carolyn believes they have been building a friendship outside work, but the perceived professional distance at work makes her disappointed and unsure about Marilyn's feelings or boundaries.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. Marilyn's response suggests the distance was not intentional or is at least something she is willing to address; she is open to improving their work dynamic.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: The work distance may be a communication or boundary issue rather than rejection; they can discuss expectations and improve collaboration.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Disappointed and confused, then somewhat reassured and hopeful.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To address their work dynamic directly and improve collaboration.

temporal_state_chain.observed: After their private meeting, Carolyn believes they cleared the air and understand each other's professional expectations and personal boundaries. When Carolyn proposes teaming up on the new project proposal, Marilyn agrees enthusiastically and says she looks forward to working more closely.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Carolyn believes she and Marilyn have cleared the air and better understand each other's professional expectations and personal boundaries; she feels content and optimistic.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: It reinforces and confirms her belief rather than reversing it. Marilyn's agreement and enthusiasm show that the improved relationship and closer collaboration are mutually welcome.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Carolyn and Marilyn have a stronger, more understanding working partnership and can collaborate successfully on the new project.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To team up with Marilyn on the new project proposal and further their partnership.
